title: OpenInference model name is read from llm.response.model_name, then llm.model_name, then llm.request.model_name
answers: trace model badge missing when inputs and outputs are hidden for OpenInference spans
OpenInference span shows request alias instead of resolved model name
llm.request.model_name or llm.response.model_name not recognized in MLflow traces
body:
Symptom: a trace from an OpenInference-instrumented LLM span shows no model, or the requested alias (e.g. 'jev-latest') instead of the resolved model, especially when inputs/outputs are redacted or hidden.
Root cause: mlflow/tracing/otel/translation/open_inference.py:OpenInferenceTranslator.MODEL_NAME_KEYS listed only llm.model_name and embedding.model_name, so spans that carry only the request/response attributes produced no model.
Fix pattern: keep MODEL_NAME_KEYS as an ordered list and add the newer keys in precedence order: llm.response.model_name, llm.model_name, llm.request.model_name, then embedding.model_name. The first non-empty value wins.
Constraints: an explicit MLflow model attribute (SpanAttributeKey.MODEL, mlflow.llm.model) already set on the span stays authoritative and must not be overwritten (test_translate_model_name_from_inputs_outputs). Empty string and null values must fall through to the next key. Keep the response-before-request order; the request alias is only a fallback. Any docs table listing OpenInference model keys must be updated with the same list.
Tests: tests/tracing/otel/test_span_translation.py:test_translate_openinference_model_name covers raw and JSON-encoded values, precedence, and empty/null fallback; test_translate_openinference_structured_inputs_outputs covers redacted TypeSafe payloads with zero output tokens.
applies: Server-side OpenInference span translation in translate_span_when_storing; applies to any new OpenInference model-name key, not to the MLflow-native model attribute.
says: The trace view displays an alias instead of the resolved model name.
Model name badge is completely missing on trace spans with redacted inputs.
Show the actual response model name rather than the requested model tag in traces.
Why is the model name empty on tracing spans when outputs are hidden?
Trace details should display the resolved model even if input data is masked.
search: In server-side OpenInference span translation in translate_span_when_storing, model names are extracted using MODEL_NAME_KEYS in priority order: llm.response.model_name, llm.model_name, llm.request.model_name, and embedding.model_name. The first non-empty value is used, falling through on empty strings or null values so request aliases serve only as a fallback. An existing explicit MLflow model attribute on the span takes precedence and must not be overwritten, nor does this rule apply to native model attributes. Defined in mlflow/tracing/otel/translation/open_inference.py and tested in tests/tracing/otel/test_span_translation.py across raw, JSON-encoded, and redacted payloads.
